theorems.name: Submission.fiw_tb_tda_poincare_sum
theorems.statement: ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0, ∀ (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ (u : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0∞), Measurable u → (∀ h : Eucl (m + 1), ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal |u (x + h) - u x| ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ‖h‖ * Λ) → ∑' F : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1), ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ (m + 1))⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x in latticeFace ρ F, ∫⁻ y in latticeFace ρ F, ENNReal.ofReal |u x - u y| ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * Λ
